evidence.detail: Scene static registration constructs rs/G from tile-space bounds, world-space bounds and an occlusion type, stores records per plane, and keeps counts for each plane.

Scene activation scans the current plane's rs/G records against the camera visibility map; only records intersecting visible cells and lying beyond camera-side thresholds are promoted into the active rs/G list.
For active records, Scene derives camera-relative slope values from the record's X/Y/Z bounds and later uses those projected ranges in point/tile/object visibility tests.

proposals.note: Occluder is the conservative modern semantic name for this exact scene-occlusion volume record; it does not claim recovery of a verbatim original-source identifier.
